InternVL-U · VBVR-CustomEval

Target-Frame Prediction: Eval Results

Real generations from InternVL-U (base checkpoint, no VBVR fine-tuning) on the 1-step-target-frame-prediction eval split — 900 samples, 100 per active task, across 9 of the 10 LOCKED_TASKS (glass_refraction has no eval split yet: its DataFactory generator repo is access-restricted, see README). Each sample: one conditioning image in, one generated image out. Every sample is scored two ways: the existing rule-based image-only pipeline (task_specific dimension, same convention as validation/test_harness.py) and a pure Qwen3-VL-30B-fp8 judge scoring the same criteria as wrong/partial/correct (see the companion "Rule vs. Judge Scoring" artifact for the full per-task rubric and prompt text). The gallery below shows 10 freshly-random samples per task (seed 42, not cherry-picked) with both scores side by side.
